text: AI is quickly changing how we work, and its impact is visible across many industries. One major effect is automation, where machines now handle repetitive tasks like data entry or sorting emails. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and complex problems. At the same time, productivity tools powered by AI help us write reports faster, schedule meetings, and analyze large amounts of information in seconds. However, this doesn’t mean humans are replaced. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming the norm, with people supervising AI systems and making final decisions. Of course, these changes mean some jobs will disappear, but new roles, such as AI trainers or ethics advisors, are also emerging. The key is to adapt and learn new skills.
